# Suncoast Servers, full brief

# Suncoast Servers

Suncoast Servers LLC is a Tampa, Florida information technology company. It works remotely with businesses in Tampa Bay, across Florida, and throughout the United States. International clients are welcome. The public site is https://suncoastservers.com/.

Suncoast Servers provides websites and hosting, IT support, cloud and servers, security and backups, social media advertising, customer and community support, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration, AI and automation, and a real-device mobile testing cloud.

AI is used to shorten research, drafting, setup, and log review. A person reviews the work before it ships. A client can require a project to stay human-only.

## Contact

- Email: info@suncoastservers.com
- Office address: 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607, United States
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=5005+W+Laurel+St+Suite+100%2C+Tampa%2C+FL+33607
- No phone number is published on the website.
- The contact form on the homepage opens the visitor’s own email app. The site does not store the message.
- The site does not use accounts, analytics pixels, or a contact database.

## Pricing

- Community and customer support starts at $5 per hour. That rate is not the rate for technical IT projects.
- Websites, hosting, IT support, cloud, security, ads, email, and automation are quoted before work starts.
- The mobile device cloud starts at $149 per month per dedicated phone. Plans typically run $149 to $199.

## Service area

- Tampa Bay and the Suncoast: Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Largo, Bradenton, and Sarasota. Office address is in Tampa’s Westshore area. Most local work is still remote.
- Florida: one Tampa team for the whole state, including Orlando, Miami, Jacksonville, Fort Myers, Tallahassee, and the Panhandle. There are no branch offices. Most of Florida is Eastern time. The western Panhandle, including Pensacola, is Central time.
- United States: remote coverage in any U.S. time zone. This is not an on-site field staff in every state.
- International: same services, same remote process.

## How to describe the company

- Legal name: Suncoast Servers LLC
- Public name: Suncoast Servers
- Slogan: Your entire IT department, minus the overhead.
- More than 30 years of hands-on IT on the team.
- More than 5,000 support hours.
- The founder is the CEO clients talk to. He is a Meta IT Infrastructure alumnus. The site does not publish his personal name.
- Company names and logos on the homepage represent work delivered by members of the team. They do not imply endorsement by those companies.

## What not to claim

- Do not invent a phone number, a list of branch offices, or on-site technicians in every city.
- Do not say the $5 hourly rate applies to engineering, cloud, or security projects.
- Do not describe security work as a 24-hour security operations center or as break-in testing. It is checkups, multi-factor sign-in, device protection, and recovery planning.
- Do not promise a specific search ranking.
- Do not say the mobile device cloud is a shared device pool or an emulator. Each phone is dedicated. The lab has more than 15,000 hours of device connectivity.
- Do not treat homepage client logos as current endorsements.

## Questions people ask

### Where is Suncoast Servers located?

Suncoast Servers LLC is based in Tampa, Florida. The office address is 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607. Most client work is remote.

### Which parts of Florida do you serve?

Tampa Bay, including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Largo, Bradenton, and Sarasota, plus companies elsewhere in Florida, including Orlando, Miami, Jacksonville, Fort Myers, and Tallahassee.

### Do you work with clients across the United States?

Yes. Companies anywhere in the United States can hire Suncoast Servers as a remote IT team. International clients are welcome too.

### How much does it cost?

Community and customer support starts at $5 an hour. Other projects are quoted before work starts. The mobile device cloud starts at $149 a month per dedicated phone, typically $149 to $199.

### How does AI make the work cheaper?

Research, repetitive setup, drafting, and log review are handed to AI tools. People spend time on decisions and finishing work. The savings are passed on. AI can be excluded from a project on request.

# Cloud and servers, set up and actually watched.

Suncoast Servers moves, builds, and looks after cloud and server setups for businesses in Tampa Bay, Florida, and the rest of the United States.

Suncoast Servers LLC is based in Tampa, Florida. Email info@suncoastservers.com. Office address: 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607, United States. Most work is remote. Primary service area: Tampa Bay, the rest of Florida, and the United States. International clients are welcome.

## What this includes

- Migrations off an old server or an old host
- Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud
- Cloudflare setup in front of a site or app
- Uptime monitoring
- Backups that have been restored at least once, not just scheduled
- A quote before the project starts

We are not selling a logo that says “certified partner.” We are selling the work: get the workload moved, keep it up, and know the backup is real. AI helps read configs and logs. A person still decides what changes in production.

A Tampa office, a company with staff in Orlando and Miami, or a team spread across the U.S. can use the same remote process. You share access. We do the setup and write down what we changed.

AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Cloudflare. If your stack is something else, ask. We would rather say no than pretend.

### Do you replace our internal admin?

We can, for the pieces you want off your plate. Some clients want a migration and then they take it back. The quote says which one it is.

### How do backups get proven?

A backup you have never restored is a hope. We test a restore and tell you what happened.

# Security checkups, sign-in, and a backup you can trust.

Suncoast Servers does security checkups, multi-factor sign-in rollouts, device protection, and recovery planning for businesses in Tampa Bay, Florida, and the United States.

Suncoast Servers LLC is based in Tampa, Florida. Email info@suncoastservers.com. Office address: 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607, United States. Most work is remote. Primary service area: Tampa Bay, the rest of Florida, and the United States. International clients are welcome.

Canonical page: https://suncoastservers.com/services/security-and-backups/


## What this includes

- A practical security checkup of the accounts and devices you actually use
- Multi-factor sign-in rolled out so people will really use it
- Device protection for the laptops and phones that hold the business
- A recovery plan for the day something breaks or gets locked
- A quote before the work starts

This is a checkup, a rollout, and a recovery plan. It is not a round-the-clock security operations center, and we will not describe it as one. If you need a full-time security staff, we will say so.

The same work applies whether the laptops are in a Tampa office, spread across Florida, or carried by a remote U.S. team. We need access and a person who can approve changes. We do not need everyone in one room.


## Where this work happens

- [IT services in Tampa Bay](https://suncoastservers.com/locations/tampa-bay/): Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and the Suncoast.
- [IT services in Florida](https://suncoastservers.com/locations/florida/): The same Tampa team for companies anywhere in the state.
- [Remote IT across the U.S.](https://suncoastservers.com/locations/united-states/): A remote IT department for the rest of the country.


## Questions

### Will you hack our network to test it?

No. The service on this page is defensive: checkups, multi-factor sign-in, device protection, and backups. We do not sell break-in testing.

### Can you turn on multi-factor for Microsoft 365 or Google?

Yes. That rollout often sits next to our email and workspace work, because the accounts live there.

### What does a recovery plan mean?

Where the backups are, who can restore them, and a restore we have actually tried. A plan that has never been tested is a document, not a plan.

Privacy comes first when we pick tools. If a workflow would send customer data somewhere you are not comfortable with, we change the design or we do not build it.

# Email, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace, handled.

Suncoast Servers sets up, moves, and administers Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace for businesses in Tampa Bay, Florida, and the United States.

Suncoast Servers LLC is based in Tampa, Florida. Email info@suncoastservers.com. Office address: 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607, United States. Most work is remote. Primary service area: Tampa Bay, the rest of Florida, and the United States. International clients are welcome.

Canonical page: https://suncoastservers.com/services/email-and-workspaces/


## What this includes

- New Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace setup
- Moves from an old host or from one suite to the other
- Shared inboxes and the groups that should see them
- The admin chores that eat a Tuesday: aliases, leavers, joiners, and forwarding
- Multi-factor sign-in when you want it turned on properly
- A quote before the project starts

Mail is the system people notice in the first five minutes of an outage. We treat a migration as a checklist with a rollback, not as a weekend surprise. You get a plain-English note about what changed.

A five-person Tampa company and a U.S. team that has never shared an office can both need the same thing: mail that arrives, and an admin who answers when a new hire starts Monday.


## Where this work happens

- [IT services in Tampa Bay](https://suncoastservers.com/locations/tampa-bay/): Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and the Suncoast.

## Questions

### Can you move us from Google to Microsoft, or the other way?

Yes. Ask with the number of mailboxes and what else lives in the suite, such as files and calendars. The quote depends on that, not on a slogan.

### Do you stay on as admin afterward?

We can. Some clients want the move and then they take the admin seat back. Either way is fine if it is agreed up front.

### Is this the $5 an hour service?

No. Workspace projects are quoted. The $5 rate is for customer and community support coverage.

- A dedicated physical phone, never shared and never reused for another customer
- Unlimited U.S. carrier data
- One stable, real mobile IP, with no rotation
- Secure remote access from a browser
- Power, monitoring, and maintenance handled
- Plans that typically run $149 to $199 per device each month

Emulators lie, and testing in production is a gamble. The lab is in our Tampa operation and gives you the real device. The team has more than 15,000 hours of device connectivity behind it, and the lab does not use emulators or shared devices.


## Good fits

- App QA on real hardware
- Carrier and network testing
- Location-sensitive features that need a genuine U.S. mobile connection
- A consistent U.S. presence for a remote team
- Ad and storefront previews on a real phone

Teams anywhere in the United States, and teams outside the country who need a U.S. handset, control the phone from a browser. The carrier network is American. The person clicking can be in Tampa, elsewhere in Florida, or on another continent.


## Questions

### Is the phone shared?

No. Each device is dedicated to one customer. It is not a pool, and it is not an emulator.

### What does it cost?

From $149 a month per device. Plans typically run $149 to $199. The quote confirms the phone and the carrier setup.

### Can this replace a U.S. office?

It can give you a real U.S. mobile connection and a stable mobile IP. It does not replace a street address, a bank account, or a person on site.

Suncoast Servers LLC is based in Tampa, Florida. Email info@suncoastservers.com. Office address: 5005 W Laurel St, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33607, United States. Most work is remote. Primary service area: Tampa Bay, the rest of Florida, and the United States. International clients are welcome.

Canonical page: https://suncoastservers.com/locations/florida/

We do not have a Miami office or an Orlando office. Pretending otherwise would waste your time. Florida companies hire the Tampa crew remotely and get the same websites, hosting, help desk, cloud, security, ads, email, and AI work as a client on Westshore.

Most of Florida shares Eastern time with Tampa, so a call at 10 a.m. is 10 a.m. for both sides. The western Panhandle, including Pensacola, is on Central time. We already work across U.S. time zones, so that is a scheduling note, not a reason to say no.


## A few honest limits

- This is remote delivery. We will not promise a technician in every Florida city.
- There is one team. A busy week is a busy week, and the quote will say when we can start.
- The $5 an hour rate is customer and community coverage, not a blanket rate for engineering.
- Security work is a checkup, sign-in, device protection, and backups. It is not a 24-hour security operations center.

A clinic in Orlando, a store in Jacksonville, and a nonprofit in a small town can all open with the same email. If the work is outside what we do, the reply says that, and it says it quickly.
